wheatfield.location_zh: 美国纽约曼哈顿，Battery Park 填埋区
wheatfield.notes_en: The commissioning organisation lists conflicting site areas; no area figure is used here. The Chinese title is a working translation.

tree-mountain.notes_en: Four hundred years is the intended protection and care horizon, not a verified outcome. The studio image combines photographs and a diagram; the complete composition is preserved in the detail view.

7000-oaks.location_zh: 德国卡塞尔；后延展至纽约等地
7000-oaks.notes_en: Despite the title, the project includes tree species other than oaks. The reference photograph shows a later landscape, not the 1982 planting.

revival-field.location_zh: 最初试验场：美国明尼苏达州圣保罗，Pig’s Eye 填埋场
revival-field.notes_en: The implementation date is 1991; early conception dates to 1989. Tests explored plants’ capacity to accumulate some metals, not complete remediation of the site.

touch-sanitation.notes_en: This work addresses maintenance, labor, and social ecology. It is not a vegetation restoration project.

ice-watch.location_zh: 丹麦哥本哈根；法国巴黎；英国伦敦
ice-watch.notes_en: Minik Rosing is a co-creator. The project began in 2014; the selected photograph documents London in 2018. Ice configurations varied between presentations.

what-is-missing.location_zh: 多个实体地点及线上；选图为美国旧金山加州科学院
what-is-missing.notes_en: The selected photograph shows The Listening Cone (2009), one component of the larger What Is Missing? project.

ghost-forest.location_zh: 美国纽约，麦迪逊广场公园
ghost-forest.notes_en: According to the commissioning organisation, these trees were already scheduled for removal as part of ecological regeneration in New Jersey’s Pine Barrens. The artist did not fell a healthy forest for this installation.

midway.notes_en: Selected photograph CF000313, 2009. A single image cannot establish the bird’s sole cause of death. This photograph is distinct from the later film Albatross. The image includes a dead animal.

plastikophobia.location_zh: 新加坡滨海堤坝，Sustainable Singapore Gallery
plastikophobia.notes_en: The installation uses plastic cups, not bottles. These are staged installation photographs, not unarranged records of a polluted site. The photographer’s online-use terms apply; no blanket public permission is assumed.

fair-park-lagoon.location_zh: 美国得克萨斯州达拉斯，Fair Park
fair-park-lagoon.notes_en: Sources describe ecological performance following implementation. This should not be presented as a current water-quality monitoring result.

beijing-besieged.location_zh: 中国北京及周边垃圾填埋场
beijing-besieged.notes_en: The two reference images are distributor promotional images or film stills, not verified titled photographic editions. The film’s copyright year is 2011; the distributor lists a 2012 release. The second image is a small thumbnail.
